title: Volver a votar
goal: Read how, one after another between 1979 and 1990, Latin American countries returned to elected civilian government -- gradually in some cases, after a political crisis in others -- and then faced the debt crisis.

items: List several countries and the years they returned to civilian rule.
Contrast gradual transitions with those that followed a political crisis.
Name presidents such as Roldós, Belaúnde Terry, Siles Zuazo and Alfonsín who took office as civilian rule returned.
Explain what new civilian governments inherited economically.
Use uno tras otro to describe a rapid succession of cases.
I can list several countries and the years they returned to civilian rule.
